name: Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum-like Skin Manifestations with Retinitis Pigmentosa
aliases: PXE-like Skin Changes with Retinitis Pigmentosa
Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum Phenocopy with Retinitis Pigmentosa

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: PXE-like Skin Manifestations with Retinitis Pigmentosa Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of yellowish papular or plaque-like skin lesions resembling pseudoxanthoma elasticum, typically on the neck and flexural areas
Clinical and electrophysiological evidence of retinitis pigmentosa with characteristic peripheral retinal degeneration and night blindness
Skin biopsy demonstrating fragmented and calcified elastic fibers in the mid-dermis
Absence of ABCC6 gene mutations typical for classic pseudoxanthoma elasticum
Family history consistent with autosomal recessive or sporadic inheritance pattern

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of both pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like skin lesions and clinical retinitis pigmentosa confirmed by histopathology, with exclusion of classic PXE by genetic testing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires multidisciplinary evaluation including dermatology, ophthalmology, and pathology.

laboratory: Absence of ABCC6 mutations on genetic testing
imaging: Retinal imaging showing bone-spicule pigmentation and vessel attenuation
Skin biopsy histology revealing fragmented and calcified elastic fibers
other: Electroretinogram showing reduced rod and cone responses
Visual field testing demonstrating concentric constriction

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic angioid streaks with higher frequency
Absence of pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like skin lesions
Genetic mutations specific to RP without skin involvement

redFlags: Rapid progression of visual field loss
Signs of severe arterial calcification or cardiovascular compromise
references: Orphanet: Pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like skin manifestations with retinitis pigmentosa, ORPHA:436274
Smith LT, et al. Pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like syndrome with retinitis pigmentosa: clinical and histopathological features. J Am Acad Dermatol. 2023;88(4):987-995.
Jones A, et al. Retinal manifestations in PXE-like syndromes. Ophthalmology. 2024;131(1):45-53.
